scripts.git-status: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');console.log('--- git status ---');console.log(execSync('git status --porcelain').toString()||'(clean)');console.log('--- git diff (stat) ---');console.log(execSync('git diff --stat').toString()||'(no diff)');"
scripts.diag-prisma: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const p=(f)=>{try{return fs.existsSync(f)}catch(e){return 'err:'+e.message}};console.log('local node_modules/prisma:', p('node_modules/prisma'));console.log('local .bin/prisma:', p('node_modules/.bin/prisma'));console.log('local @prisma/client:', p('node_modules/@prisma/client'));console.log('which prisma:');try{console.log(execSync('which prisma').toString())}catch(e){console.log('not found:', e.message)}console.log('node version:', process.version);try{console.log('local prisma pkg version:', require('./node_modules/prisma/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('cannot read local prisma package.json:', e.message)}"
scripts.db:backup: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const u=new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL);const ts=new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');const file=`backup-${ts}.sql`;execSync(`mysqldump -h ${u.hostname} -u ${u.username} -p'${u.password}' ${u.pathname.slice(1)} > ${file}`,{shell:'/bin/bash'});console.log('backup written to', file);"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['node_modules/@next/swc-wasm-nodejs','node_modules/@next/swc-wasm-web']){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}console.log('stripped unusable swc-wasm fallback packages');"
scripts.test-swc-load: node -e "process.env.NEXT_DISABLE_SWC_WASM='1';const swc=require('next/dist/build/swc');swc.loadBindings().then(()=>console.log('bindings loaded OK')).catch(e=>console.log('load failed (expected, not a crash):', e.message))"
scripts.test-oxide-load: node -e "const fs=require('fs');console.log('wasi pkg present:', fs.existsSync('node_modules/@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi'));try{const oxide=require('@tailwindcss/oxide');console.log('oxide loaded OK:', typeof oxide.Scanner)}catch(e){console.log('oxide load failed:', e.message)}"
scripts.test-minimal-wasm: node -e "const bytes=new Uint8Array([0,97,115,109,1,0,0,0]);WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes).then(()=>console.log('minimal wasm instantiate OK')).catch(e=>console.log('minimal wasm instantiate FAILED:', e.message))"
scripts.test-minimal-wasm-notrap: node --no-wasm-trap-handler -e "const bytes=new Uint8Array([0,97,115,109,1,0,0,0]);WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes).then(()=>console.log('minimal wasm instantiate OK (no-trap-handler)')).catch(e=>console.log('minimal wasm instantiate FAILED (no-trap-handler):', e.message))"
